decision_rule.profile_qualified_when: all four profile hard gates, representation gate, and all common technical controls pass in the same saved image

common_technical_controls.description: The original adult fictional subject preserves recognizable visible face-shape, eye-aperture and spacing, lower-face, hairline, and long dark-hair cues from the attached portrait without making an identity claim.
The subject remains visibly adult without de-aging or doll-like reshaping.
Bodies, limbs, instruments, displays, and required spatial relations are coherent enough to support the tested scene.
Any handrail, telescope control, tool, or instrument interaction required by the assigned event has readable physical contact.
Pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks, or signage do not supply missing scientific meaning.

arm-01-barred-galaxy.description: One central bulge anchors the galactic disk.
An elongated stellar bar crosses the central bulge.
Spiral arms visibly begin near the two bar ends.
Bulge, bar, and arms occupy one coherent disk.
The display reads as a false-color or multiwavelength scientific observation rather than an ordinary-color direct view or fictional portal.

arm-02-microgravity.description: Station racks, handrails, and stowage establish an orbital interior.
Multiple bodies or objects float without visible support.
Floating elements have no shared downward orientation.
Rails or restraints are actively used for motion control.
The station scene reads as visible-light operational documentary rather than wire levitation or a rotated studio set.

arm-03-solar-flare.description: Solar disk or limb context owns the burst.
A localized magnetic active region remains identifiable.
A compact intense brightening or paired ribbons occupy that region.
Connected coronal response remains local to the burst.
The display reads as a false-color or multiwavelength solar observation rather than a detached fictional explosion.
